{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

valid_biomarker = df['biomarker_baseline'][df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999.0]

# Compute the mean of valid baseline biomarker values
mean_valid_biomarker = valid_biomarker.mean()
